Test Scenario: Register with all valid data
Preconditions: The buyer registration screen is open. The email, mobile number and other unique values in the test data are not yet registered.
Test Steps:
1. Fill in every field with the test data.
2. Tap Register.
Test Data:
First Name: Juan Miguel
Last Name: Dela Cruz
Email: juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com
Mobile Number: 09171234567
Date of Birth: 05/14/1998
Password: Mamimili@2026
Confirm Password: Mamimili@2026
Terms and Privacy Policy: Ticked
Expected Result: The form is accepted with no validation errors. A success message is shown, a 6-digit OTP is sent to the email, and the email verification screen opens. The account is saved with status Unverified.

Test Scenario: Submit a completely empty form
Preconditions: The buyer registration screen is open.
Test Steps:
1. Leave every field blank and every dropdown on its default option.
2. Tap Register.
Expected Result: Registration is blocked. A required-field message is shown for every mandatory field. No account is created and no OTP is sent.

Test Scenario: Leave one required field blank at a time
Preconditions: The buyer registration screen is open.
Test Steps:
1. Fill in all fields with valid data.
2. Clear one required field.
3. Tap Register.
4. Repeat for each field in the test data.
Test Data:
Clear in turn:
First Name
Last Name
Email
Mobile Number
Date of Birth
Password
Confirm Password
Expected Result: Each time, registration is blocked and a required-field message is shown on the blank field only. Other entered values (except passwords and uploads) are kept. No account is created.

2. Leave the Terms and Privacy Policy checkbox unticked.

Test Scenario: Tap Register several times quickly
Preconditions: The buyer registration screen is open. The email, mobile number and other unique values in the test data are not yet registered.
Test Steps:
1. Fill in all fields with the Account 2 data from the Test Data sheet.
2. Tap Register three times in quick succession.
Test Data: Account 2 data (Test Data sheet, column G)
Expected Result: Only one account is created and only one OTP email is sent. No duplicate-email error screen appears.

Test Scenario: Verify with the correct OTP
Preconditions: The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com was just registered and is Unverified. The verification screen is open and the OTP email has been read from the mail catcher.
Test Steps:
1. Enter the OTP from the email within 5 minutes.
2. Tap Verify.
Test Data: OTP: the code in the email (for example 482913)
Expected Result: Verification succeeds. The account status changes from Unverified to Pending Approval (not Active). A message says the account is waiting for admin approval and the login screen opens. The buyer home screen does not open yet.

Test Scenario: Verify with an incorrect OTP
Preconditions: The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com was just registered and is Unverified. The verification screen is open and the OTP email has been read from the mail catcher.
Test Steps:
1. Enter a code different from the one in the email.
2. Tap Verify.
Test Data: OTP: 000000 (use 111111 if the real code is 000000)
Expected Result: Verification fails with an invalid-code message. The account stays Unverified.

Test Scenario: OTP in the wrong format
Preconditions: The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com was just registered and is Unverified. The verification screen is open and the OTP email has been read from the mail catcher.
Test Steps:
1. Enter each value in the test data, one per attempt.
2. Tap Verify.
Expected Result: Each value is rejected. The account stays Unverified.

Test Scenario: Verify with an expired OTP
Preconditions: The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com was just registered and is Unverified. The verification screen is open and the OTP email has been read from the mail catcher.
Test Steps:
1. Wait until 5 minutes and 1 second have passed since the OTP was sent.
2. Enter the OTP from the email.
3. Tap Verify.
Test Data: OTP: the correct code, entered at 5:01 or later
Expected Result: Verification fails with a message that the code has expired, and a Resend option is offered. The account stays Unverified.

Test Scenario: Resend OTP
Preconditions: The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com was just registered and is Unverified. The verification screen is open and the OTP email has been read from the mail catcher.
Test Steps:
1. Tap Resend OTP.
2. Enter the first code and tap Verify.
3. Enter the second code and tap Verify.
Test Data: First code (for example 482913), then the second code (for example 907356)
Expected Result: A new OTP email arrives. The first code is rejected. The second code is accepted and the account is verified.

Test Scenario: Log in before verifying the email
Preconditions: The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com exists with status Unverified.
Test Steps:
1. Open the login screen.
2. Log in with the unverified account.
Expected Result: The user is not given access. The verification screen or a message asking to verify the email is shown.

Test Scenario: Log in with the new approved account
Preconditions: The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com is verified and has been Approved by the Admin.
Test Steps:
1. Open the login screen.
2. Enter the email and password.
3. Tap Log In.
Expected Result: Login succeeds. The buyer home screen opens and the name Juan Miguel is shown.

Test Scenario: Open another role's screens
Preconditions: The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com is logged in.
Test Steps:
1. Check every tab and menu for seller, logistics, rider or admin functions.
2. Open each deep link in the test data on the phone, one at a time (tap it in a notes app, or on Android run adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d <link>).
3. If a proxy tool is available, replay one seller API request using the buyer's session.
Test Data:
Seller dashboard deep link
Logistics dashboard deep link
Rider home deep link
Admin dashboard deep link (or the admin panel's web address)
Expected Result: No other role's menus are shown. Each deep link shows an access-denied message or returns to the buyer home screen. The API request is refused (401/403). No data from the other role is shown.

Test Scenario: [Mobile] Each field opens the right keyboard
Preconditions: The buyer Sign Up screen is open in the app on the test phone.
Test Steps:
1. Tap each field in turn, from top to bottom.
2. Note the keyboard that opens and whether word suggestions appear.
Test Data:
Email: email keyboard with @
Mobile Number: number pad
OTP (on the next screen): number pad
Password / Confirm Password: no autocorrect or suggestions
First / Last Name: capitalises each word
Expected Result: Each field opens the keyboard listed in the test data. Password fields show no autocorrect or word suggestions. No field opens a keyboard that cannot type its valid value.

Test Scenario: [Mobile] Keyboard never hides the active field or Register
Preconditions: The buyer Sign Up screen is open in the app on the test phone.
Test Steps:
1. On the smallest test phone, tap each field from top to bottom.
2. With the keyboard open on the last field, scroll to Register.
3. Tap Done or tap outside the fields.
Expected Result: The focused field always scrolls into view above the keyboard, with its error message visible. Register can be reached and tapped. The keyboard closes when Done or the background is tapped.

Test Scenario: [Mobile] App sent to the background while filling the form
Preconditions: The buyer Sign Up screen is open in the app on the test phone.
Test Steps:
1. Fill in about half the fields with Account 1 data.
2. Press Home and open another app for 1 minute, then return.
3. Lock the screen for 1 minute (or receive a phone call), then return.
Expected Result: Each time, the app returns to the same form with every typed value still there (passwords may be cleared). The app does not restart, crash or jump to the login screen. No account is created until Register is tapped.

Test Scenario: [Mobile] Rotate the phone while the form has data
Preconditions: The buyer Sign Up screen is open in the app on the test phone.
Test Steps:
1. Fill in several fields and tap Register with one field blank, so an error message shows.
2. Turn on auto-rotate and rotate the phone to landscape, then back.
Test Data: Account 1 data with Email left blank
Expected Result: Either the app stays in portrait, or the layout switches to landscape and back keeping every value and the error message. Nothing is cleared and the app does not crash.

Test Scenario: [Mobile] Register with no internet connection
Preconditions: The buyer Sign Up screen is open in the app on the test phone. The values in the test data are not yet registered.
Test Steps:
1. Fill in every field with the test data.
2. Turn on Airplane mode (Wi-Fi and mobile data off).
3. Tap Register.
4. Turn Airplane mode off and tap Register again.
Expected Result: Step 3: a clear no-internet message is shown, the typed data stays on the form, the app does not crash, and no account is created. Step 4: the account is saved once: exactly one account and one OTP email.

Test Scenario: [Mobile] Connection drops right after tapping Register
Preconditions: The buyer Sign Up screen is open in the app on the test phone. The values in the test data are not yet registered.
Test Steps:
1. Fill in every field with the test data.
2. Tap Register, then turn on Airplane mode within a second.
3. Turn Airplane mode off. If the form is still shown, tap Register again.
4. Check the mail catcher and try to log in.
Expected Result: The app shows a connection error or a waiting state, never a frozen screen. In the end exactly one account exists with this email. If the first attempt was saved, the app continues normally (or says the account already exists and lets the user continue); the account is never left in a state the user cannot reach.

Test Scenario: [Mobile] Paste the OTP copied from the mail app
Preconditions: A buyer account registered with the test data is Unverified. The verification screen is open in the app and the OTP email is open in a mail app or the mail catcher on the same phone.
Test Steps:
1. In the mail app, long-press the 6-digit code and copy it.
2. Return to the app, long-press the OTP field and tap Paste (or tap the code suggested above the keyboard).
3. Tap Verify if it does not verify by itself.
Test Data:
Email: buyer.test05@example.com
Mobile Number: 09170000004
OTP: the code in the email
Expected Result: All 6 digits fill the OTP field (every box, in order, when it is split into boxes). Verification succeeds and the status changes exactly as in the correct-OTP case.

Test Scenario: [Mobile] OTP countdown after switching to the mail app
Preconditions: A buyer account registered with the test data is Unverified and the verification screen has just opened.
Test Steps:
1. Note the time left on the verification screen.
2. Switch to the mail app for 2 minutes, then return.
3. Lock the screen until more than 5 minutes have passed since the code was sent, unlock, enter the code and tap Verify.
Test Data:
Email: buyer.test06@example.com
Mobile Number: 09170000005
OTP: the code in the email
Expected Result: After step 2 the verification screen is still open and shows about 3 minutes left (the countdown kept running; it did not restart at 5:00). In step 3 the code is rejected as expired and Resend is offered.

Test Scenario: [Mobile] System Back on the form and the verification screen
Preconditions: The buyer Sign Up screen is open in the app on the test phone.
Test Steps:
1. Fill in a few fields, then press Android Back (or swipe back on iPhone).
2. Tap Cancel in the prompt, then press Back again and confirm leaving.
3. Register with a spare email to reach the verification screen and press Back.
4. Log in with that account.
Test Data: Spare email from the Test Data sheet (for example buyer.test09@example.com)
Expected Result: Leaving a form with typed data asks first, and Cancel keeps every value. Back from the verification screen does not create a second account; the account stays Unverified, and the next login brings the user back to verification.

Test Scenario: [Mobile] Large system font on a small screen
Preconditions: The buyer Sign Up screen is open in the app on the test phone.
Test Steps:
1. Set the phone's font size and display size to the largest setting.
2. Open the buyer Sign Up screen and tap Register with every field empty.
Expected Result: All labels, placeholders, error messages and buttons can be read in full; none are cut off or overlapping. The screen scrolls to every field and Register can be tapped.

Test Scenario: [Mobile] Stay logged in after closing the app or restarting the phone
Preconditions: The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com is verified and Active, and is logged in on the test phone.
Test Steps:
1. Swipe the app away from recent apps (force close) and reopen it.
2. Restart the phone and reopen the app.
Expected Result: Each time the app opens on the buyer home screen still logged in, showing Juan Miguel. It does not ask to log in again and shows no other user's data.

Test Scenario: [Mobile] Back after logging out
Preconditions: The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com is verified and Active, and is logged in on the test phone.
Test Steps:
1. Tap Log Out.
2. Press Android Back (or swipe back) several times.
3. Reopen the app from recent apps.
Expected Result: The login screen stays. No screen with account data appears again, and the app does not log back in by itself.

Test Scenario: Log in while the account is waiting for approval
Preconditions: The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com is verified with the OTP and has status Pending Approval.
Test Steps:
1. Open the login screen.
2. Enter the email and password.
3. Tap Log In.
Expected Result: Login is blocked. A message says the account is waiting for admin approval. The buyer home screen does not open, no product or order data is shown, and the status stays Pending Approval.

Test Scenario: Admin approves the buyer
Preconditions: The buyer account juanmiguel.delacruz@example.com has status Pending Approval. The Admin is logged in on the admin panel (M1).
Test Steps:
1. As Admin, open the pending buyer applications and open this one.
2. Tap Approve.
3. On the phone, log in as the buyer.
Expected Result: The status changes to Approved and the buyer is notified by email. Login succeeds and the buyer home screen opens. The application is no longer in the Admin's pending list.

Test Scenario: Admin rejects the buyer
Preconditions: A buyer account has status Pending Approval. The Admin is logged in on the admin panel (M1).
Test Steps:
1. As Admin, open the application and tap Reject without a reason.
2. Enter the reason and tap Reject.
3. On the phone, log in as the buyer.
Test Data: Reason: Details could not be verified, please check them.
Expected Result: Step 1 is blocked because a reason is required (10 to 300 characters). After step 2 the status is Rejected and the buyer is told by email with the reason. Login is blocked with a message that the application was rejected. The buyer home screen does not open.

Test Scenario: Rejected buyer corrects the details and resubmits
Preconditions: The buyer account has status Rejected.
Test Steps:
1. Log in with the rejected account.
2. Correct the details and tap Resubmit.
3. As Admin, open the pending buyer applications.
Expected Result: The buyer can correct the details and resubmit. The status goes back to Pending Approval and the Admin sees one application for this buyer (no duplicate account).

Test Scenario: [Mobile] Waiting for approval: close and reopen the app
Preconditions: A buyer has just verified the OTP on the phone and is Pending Approval.
Test Steps:
1. Close the app completely and reopen it.
2. As Admin, approve the buyer.
3. Reopen the app and log in.
Expected Result: Step 1: the login or waiting-for-approval screen shows, never the buyer home screen. Step 3: login succeeds and the home screen opens.
